page.overview:
Who is Keaton Murag?

Keaton Murag was a human Jedi Master during the High Republic Era. Murag was elevated to the Jedi High Council. When the Council convened to decide whether to participate in action against the Nihil marauder group alongside the Galactic Republic, Murag was present in the Jedi Council Chamber personally. After ten of the eleven attending Masters voted, the vote was left with a tie, leaving Master Jora Malli to break it. Malli decided to accompany the Republic Defense Coalition effort against the Nihil.

Keaton Murag was created for the Star Wars: The High Republic publishing initiative and was introduced in the fourth episode of Star Wars: The High Republic Show on July 28, 2021.

The Art of Star Wars: The High Republic: Volume I
